overview: The Medford School Committee met to review the interim superintendent's transition plan, discuss proposed tuition increases for the district's Summer Fun program, and pass a policy on immigration law enforcement protocols.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda containing bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and minutes from the January 13, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Transition Plan
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Suzanne Galusi presented her transitional leadership plan and reaffirmed district commitments to inclusive student policies regarding federal executive orders.

items.title: Summer Fun Program Rate Card
items.summary: The committee discussed proposed fee increases for the summer camp program and voted to request an updated program budget and sliding-scale fee options for the next meeting.

items.title: Shore Educational Collaborative Appointment
items.summary: Reappointed member Paul Ruseau as the committee's representative to the Shore Educational Collaborative Board of Directors.

items.title: Immigration Law Enforcement Policy
items.summary: Approved an amended policy codifying district procedures regarding non-discrimination, student record protections, and restrictions on immigration enforcement agents accessing school buildings and buses.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of former school committee member John R. Granara Jr., James E. Morell, and Marie L. Cabanero Ward.
